name: Comic Con India (Ahmedabad)
blurb: Ahmedabad leg of Comic Con India's national pop-culture tour, run with ReedPop, with comics-industry and pop-culture guests.

last.venue: Mahatma Mandir Convention and Exhibition Centre, Gandhinagar

notes: Re-checked comicconindia.com fresh (--fresh) and probed /ahmedabad, /comic-con-ahmedabad and /all-cities-main-page/ahmedabad-comic-con, all 404; the live homepage city slider still only shows Visakhapatnam, Navi Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad and Jalandhar, confirming no 2026-27 Ahmedabad edition has been announced yet. Added 'last': Rolling Stone India and a second outlet both report the only Ahmedabad (Comic Con India) edition ran March 22-23, 2025, and a hotel/listing source (ummedhotels.com, corroborated by allevents.in) names the venue as Mahatma Mandir Convention and Exhibition Centre in Gandhinagar (the venue used for this Ahmedabad-branded edition).
